bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (2019 Measures No. 3) Bill 2019

name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2020-06-15.182.1) to a motion regarding when to consider the message from the House, which means that the message will be considered immediately. ### Original motion text > *That consideration of message No. 218 in Committee of the Whole be made an order of the day for the next day of sitting.* ### Amendment text > *That all words after 'That' be omitted and replaced with 'the message be considered in Committee of the Whole immediately'.*
question: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2020-06-15.182.1) to a motion regarding when to consider the message from the House, which means that the message will be considered immediately. ### Original motion text > *That consideration of message No. 218 in Committee of the Whole be made an order of the day for the next day of sitting.* ### Amendment text > *That all words after 'That' be omitted and replaced with 'the message be considered in Committee of the Whole immediately'.*
